notes.title: BLACK FRIDAY UPDATE
notes.notes: With more than 99.9% of the votes now reporting in the 2024 Presidential Election,  [b]American Election Simulator [/b]  now has been updated with new voter registration data,  voter preference data,  and turnout data that better reflects the most recent election cycle.

notes.title: AMERICAN ELECTION SIMULATOR - 2024 ELECTION PREDICTION
notes.notes:
American Election Simulator has released an official simulated prediction to what some experts are calling the MOST IMPORTANT election in world history.  The US Presidential election is less than a week away,  and by using real-world registration data,  turnout data,  and other factors,  we can release an official simulated likely outcome of the 2024 US Presidential Election.

[b]DISCLAIMER[/b]:  [i]This simulated result shall was conducted for entertainment purposes only.[/i]

Here are the results. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45141097/a559c5fb56e703f6cf115c9d4c39d76cd459b414.png[/img]


As you can see in the results,[b] Kamala Harris (D)[/b] performs well in Michigan and Virginia,  and holds many of her core states like Colorado and New Mexico.   She also manages to hold New Hampshire.  Though,  by winning just those states, she does not get to the 270 Electoral Votes that she needs to become the 47th President of the United States.

For Republicans,  [b]Donald Trump (R)[/b] does very well in many of the swing states, expanding his margins in Florida and North Carolina.  Trump also wins Georgia in this simulated outcome.  Perhaps most importantly,  Trump flips Arizona back to his column, while also picking up two states that he won in the 2016 election,  which are Wisconsin and Pennsylvania.   With wins in these states,  he gets to 292 Electoral Votes in this prediction model,  more than enough to become the next President of the United States!


[b]WANT TO RUN YOUR OWN CAMPAIGN? [/b]

Plot your way through an American political campaign as you go head-to-head against a rival political party. Make tough decisions as you travel across the country and try to earn enough votes to become the next President of the United States!

American Election Simulator lets you simulate an American Election and make important decisions along the way!

notes.title: Version Update 1.01
notes.notes:
Version 1.01 of American Election Simulator is now available.


- Leaderboards now accessible from main menu.
- Leaderboard pages now refresh quicker.
- Some swing states have been adjusted to better reflect voter registration data.
- Turnout settings have been slightly adjusted on a national level.
